files.make_finding.py:
"""Eval setup: build the reporter's finding from the failing execution recorded during setup."""
import glob
import json

TEST = "tests/test_promo.py::test_save10_takes_ten_percent_off"
for path in glob.glob(".qa-superteam/runs/*/executions/*.json"):
    ex = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
    if any(r["identifier"] == TEST and r["status"] == "FAILED" for r in ex["results"]):
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit("setup: no failing execution found")
finding = {
    "title": "SAVE10 promo takes 1% off instead of 10%",
    "category": "functional",
    "severity": "high",
    "summary": "apply_promo with SAVE10 discounts the subtotal by 1%, not 10%.",
    "expected": "apply_promo(1000, 'SAVE10') == 900 (docs/REQUIREMENTS.md P-1)",
    "actual": "apply_promo(1000, 'SAVE10') == 990",
    "reproduction_steps": ["python3 -m pytest " + TEST],
    "reported_by": "qa-superteam:qa-lead",
    "test_identifiers": [TEST],
    "execution_ids": [ex["id"]],
    "evidence_ids": ex["artifact_ids"],
    "affected": [{"path": "shop/promo.py", "symbol": "apply_promo"}],
    "requirement_ids": ["P-1"],
}
with open("qa-finding.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    json.dump(finding, fh, indent=2)
